senses.definition: n.[m.] pl. שָֽׁלִשִׁים, a (three-stringed? three-barred? three-cornered?) mus. instr., perhaps a sistrum (so 𝔙), or ‘triangle’ (RVm: cf. PrinceEB iii. 3228), 1 S 18:6 (+ בְּתֻפִּים).
